title: Migrate leaderboard _ModelEntry from TypedDict to dataclass
description:
Replace `_ModelEntry` in `puppeteer/src/puppeteer/leaderboard.py` with a dataclass and update the local leaderboard helpers that construct, sort, and serialize it.

Keep this PR intentionally small: do not migrate any schema export types in the same change. Limit the work to leaderboard code and the direct tests that cover leaderboard output.

This is the smallest migration slice and a good first PR for proving the pattern.
